Routine en route cruise.provides: predictable trajectories, ample separation, no immediate action needed

Converging traffic conflict.provides: minutes to resolve, a vectoring or level solution required

Aircraft in distress.provides: priority handling, airspace cleared around it

Total radar failure.provides: no position information, procedural separation only

Radar vectoring.requires: a surveillance picture and radio contact

Level allocation.provides: separation without changing track, dependence on aircraft performance

Procedural separation.provides: separation without radar, very large spacing required

Datalink clearance.requires: an equipped aircraft and a working datalink
Datalink clearance.provides: uplinked instructions, no voice channel needed

Normal two-way radio.requires: a serviceable radio on both sides

Radio failure on the aircraft.provides: no instruction can reach the aircraft by voice, a lost-communication procedure followed

Frequency congestion.provides: delayed transmissions, no loss of capability

Separation maintained.provides: no loss of separation, normal operations continue

Loss of separation reported.provides: a mandatory occurrence report, an investigation opened

Airprox with avoiding action.requires: a close encounter and a collision avoidance manoeuvre
Airprox with avoiding action.provides: a crew-initiated manoeuvre, separation restored by the aircraft

Conflict undetected by anyone.provides: no report raised, no action taken
